summary: Amazon's API for sellers and vendors to manage listings, orders, inventory, reports and fulfillment.
access_note: Must register as an SP-API developer with a professional selling account; private apps are self-authorized, public apps need Appstore listing. Restricted roles may need approval.
blocker_note: Public multi-seller apps must be listed in the Selling Partner Appstore; developer registration and professional seller account required.

evidence.quote: A Login with Amazon (LWA) access token authorizes your application to take certain actions on behalf of a selling partner.
you must have a professional selling account to develop SP-API private seller applications.
To request an LWA access token, make a secure HTTP POST to the LWA authentication server
A local MCP server that bundles SP-API developer tools into a single npm package
